title: Shermans' direwolf survives a 12-gauge shotgun

tellings.quote: >> Yeah, large direwolf that actually attacked their prized cattle.

plain: Brandon Fugal, the owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property famous for strange reports, tells of the Sherman family, who lived there in the mid 1990s. According to Fugal, citing a Deseret News newspaper report by Zack Van Eyk, a huge wolf-like animal attacked their prized cattle and was shot with a 12-gauge shotgun yet seemed unharmed, which would suggest something far from an ordinary animal.
